control_comparison.note: Exact-key is a separate mixture diagnostic and is never blended into candidate quality.  The oracle is a gold-target diagnostic, not a legal policy.

runtime_selection.note: Runtime selection metrics are artifact runtime fields where available; they are not recomputed by threshold replay.

layer_view.description: Per-layer metrics are readout rows.  The same query appears in every layer and layers are not independent samples.

query_view.description: Query metrics combine both layers: any accepted layer, all layers accepted and correct, all layers zero or tied.

wrong_address_categories.note: Categories are assigned after runtime acceptance from kind/cross-world scoring fields and are never threshold inputs.

non_claims: No learned-memory, learned-selector, generated-answer or calibrated-confidence claim.
Address-grid results are address-arm diagnostics only; they do not simulate downstream candidate refresh or reselection.
Development-only threshold exploration is not a native policy or a held-out result.
Prepared04 heldout is already spent and is not reused for calibration or confirmation.

runtime_decision.acceptance_rule: usable and not policy-blocked and top_cosine >= cosine_floor and top_cosine - second_cosine >= margin_floor

artifact_acceptance_comparison.comparison: native runtime rule versus artifact accepted flag
artifact_acceptance_comparison.note: The artifact accepted flag is a cross-check only; the calibration decision is independently recomputed from readout fields and the declared floors.

runtime_decision.zero_or_tied_rule: readout_norm > 0 and top_cosine != second_cosine; otherwise the row receives no recoverability or acceptance credit

units.note: declared query rows are before state duplication; inventory case rows are state-expanded; arm-expanded rows multiply by variants, layers and kind-eligible arms (exact_key_value only for facts)
